queries.name: GetRfcLifecycleProjection
queries.output: current accepted RFC source fields with exact evidence references, derived status_class/authority, current terminal epoch if any, local archive state, unresolved warnings
queries.ordering: single result; source fields render in closed field-registry order
queries.rule: source evidence bodies/history are read through LLD-04; this query exposes accepted current ticket projection only

queries.name: PreviewRfcArchive
queries.output: server-computed exact SOMA_RFC_ARCHIVE_SCOPE_V1 full-scope fingerprint/member counts plus one bounded page of member IDs/revisions/archive states and change/exclusion classification
queries.ordering: scope ordinal ASC, rfc_id ASC; exact_rfc has requested RFC ordinal 0; reviewed_branch has requested parentless root ordinal 0 then direct children by rfc_id UTF-8 ASC
rules: one stable read snapshot computes the complete scope/fingerprint before serving page data
fingerprint binds complete current membership, member revisions and archive states even though transport is paged
reviewed_branch requires requested RFC parentless and introduces no child-count business cap
cursor filter fingerprint binds rfc_id, scope_kind and complete scope_fingerprint so changed scope cannot splice pages
ArchiveRfc recomputes complete fingerprint inside writer UnitOfWork; it never trusts a client member/revision list

queries.name: GetRfcArchiveOperation
queries.output: immutable requested scope/fingerprint, exact archived-member count, one bounded operation-member page with latest per-member archive event/current restore eligibility
queries.ordering: operation member ordinal ASC, rfc_id ASC
queries.rule: operation membership never implies member is still archived by that operation after later independent actions

queries.name: PreviewRfcHardDelete
queries.output: eligible boolean, exact RFC revision, bounded typed blocker summaries, per-domain determinate/indeterminate guard results, bounded provider freshness tokens and eligibility_fingerprint
queries.ordering: closed guard registry ordinal ASC, blocker code ASC
rules: blocker summaries bounded by closed local/provider guard registry; detailed provider history stays behind provider reads
manual creation audit classified separately from post-creation protected history
any source adoption/provenance, relationship/history/lifecycle/archive/correction dependency or INDETERMINATE provider makes eligible=false
command recomputes every guard/fingerprint inside deletion UoW

pagination: Every unbounded RFC lifecycle evidence/member surface uses CURSOR_V1 keyset paging with packet-bounded page_size. Full-scope decisions use server-computed counts/fingerprints over indexed reads and never depend on unbounded client payload. Terminal-cascade member/impact paging is owned by queries/rfc-terminal-cascade.json.
